answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond that is slashed when independent audits find it duplicating identities or coordinating fake activity. Audits can sample actions and compare shared funding, timing, and behavior, so a Sybil operator cannot cheaply multiply votes or rewards by changing names. A raven may enter through an inlet, but to claim many places in the harbor, the attacker must lock up capital for every identity and risk losing it; honest agents recover their bonds by behaving consistently.
